log.title: Log the day in a minute
log.body: Hours, packages, kilometers and the car you drove. One shift, one screen.

approve.title: Your dispatcher checks it
approve.body: Send your shift and see when it's approved, or what to fix if it comes back.

pay.title: Get paid right
pay.body: Your pay follows your approved hours, so every month adds up.

signUp.title:
Create
your account
signUp.intro: Join Route Forge to log your shifts, follow approvals and see your pay on any device.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.intro: Sign in to log today's shift and check your hours.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.intro: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it below.
verify.resent: New code sent. Check your email.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your account email and we'll send you a code.

errors.emailExists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.codeIncorrect: That code isn't right. Check the email and try again.
errors.network: No connection. What you typed stays here. Try again when you're online.
errors.passwordPwned: This password appeared in a data breach. Choose a different one.
errors.useGoogle: This account signs in with Google. Use Continue with Google.
errors.codeExpired: That code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

today.title: Today
today.noShiftBody: Log your hours, packages and kilometers when you finish.

month.empty: No approved shifts yet this month.

home.offline: No connection. Try again when you're online.

shifts.title: Today's shift

start.title: Before you start

start.error: Couldn't start the shift. Try again.

time.title: Working time
time.label: Start time
time.future: The start time can't be in the future.
time.offline: No connection. The start time wasn't changed.

route.title: Route
route.endBelowStart: Must be at least the start km.

packages.title: Packages
packages.help: Delivered is worked out for you: loaded − returned. Pickups are customer returns you collected.

finish.body: After you submit, the dispatcher reviews it and you can't edit it.

finish.invalid: Some numbers need fixing. Keep editing and check the highlighted fields.
finish.error: Couldn't submit the shift. Try again.

shifts.offline: No connection. Try again when you're online.

none.title: No firm yet
none.body: Ask your dispatcher or the firm's owner to invite you. Invitations show up here.
none.acceptFailed: Couldn't accept the invitation. Check your connection and try again.

roleNotYet.title: Coming soon for your role
roleNotYet.body: Screens for dispatchers and owners are on the way. For now the app logs couriers' shifts.

notSetUp.title: Your firm isn't set up yet
notSetUp.body: Ask the firm's owner to finish setting up stations and buses.

pay.title: Pay
pay.body: Your monthly pay will show up here.
